title: Tiki Splash, LLC
specs: Boat is US Coast Guard compliant with licensed captains
Stable 26-foot tiki boat with thatched roof and tropical decor
Bluetooth sound system with guest DJ capability

services.name: Day Cruise
services.desc: Take in the golden hour and enjoy one of the best sunset experiences on the North East

gap: Exact prices for cruises not stated
blurb: Guests board a 26-foot tiki boat for a 2-hour cruise on the North East River. The boat holds up to 6 passengers plus captain and crew. Guests can bring their own food and drinks, enjoy music via a bluetooth speaker system, and may swim with captain's permission.
extraNote: Arrive 15 minutes before departure · Cancellations 14+ days before get full refund; 7-13 days get 50% refund; less than 7 days no refund · No-shows, late arrivals, unused time non-refundable · Weather cancellations get reschedule credit, no refunds · Smoking and vaping not permitted on board · Captain may suspend or cancel trip for safety reasons · North East River Marina, 724 Water St, Charlestown, MD 21914 · April 20th to October 15th
